pricing.billing_basis: submitted audio seconds; Murf publishes $0.24 per hour

protocol_caveat: Beta. Murf sends an informational SessionStarted event but no model echo, so the benchmark sends AudioConfig before binary audio. A live session reported commit_mode=vad and emitted an empty VAD final for the artificial silence tail after the manual speech final. Only the manual EndOfTurn final after Finalize is the benchmark acknowledgment; CloseStream must then close the session with code 1000.
